name: Background
description: Omarchy's carousel of the current theme's backgrounds, without its dim; Enter runs haseen theme bg set, n runs haseen theme bg next

placement.description: Where the picker opens: overlay (Omarchy's carousel over the whole screen, with no dim), center (a narrower carousel in a panel in the middle of the screen) or bar (the same in a panel under the bar); in a panel, Escape closes the picker at once, as it does a menu placed in a panel

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC target haseen.background to drive the open panel without a keyboard
